title: Concept: Origin-Agent-Cluster explicitly disables origin-keyed agent clustering
description: The response sets Origin-Agent-Cluster to ?0, opting out of origin-keyed agent clustering. Same-site documents that would otherwise be isolated then share an agent cluster, so a weaker same-site origin runs alongside the application rather than in its own process boundary.
risk: Same-site documents share an agent cluster with the application; LOW severity because the isolation loss only matters once another same-site origin is compromised.
